_comment: Documented exceptions to config/licenses/allowed-licenses.json. Each entry lets a dependency whose
license is NOT on the allowlist ship anyway, but only in the listed scopes: 'server' (pos-server.jar,
including the /admin and /pos browser bundles), 'apk' (the Android client), 'deb' (the Linux desktop
client) or 'private-only'. A matching dependency that also reaches another scope still fails.
'dependency' is 'group:name' (maven) or 'npm:name', and may use * as a wildcard. Every entry needs a
reason, an owner and a date; an entry that matches nothing is reported as stale and fails the check,
so this file cannot quietly outlive the dependency it was written for. Process: docs/claude/deployment.md.

exceptions.license: ML Kit Terms of Service (proprietary, Google)
exceptions.reason: The Android client's document scanner (Google ML Kit document scanning). QR scanning via qr-kit (network.chaintech) uses Google ML Kit barcode scanning, and the document scanner uses ML Kit document scanning; proprietary Google terms; accepted by the owner 2026-10-09; replacement with an open-source scanner, e.g. ZXing (already a dependency), tracked as one follow-up covering both scanners.
